clues.text: This city in Ghana is where main roads from four towns cross. The roads link it to Sunyani, Kumasi, Wa, and Tamale.
clues.narrowing: rules out everything outside Ghana in West Africa

source.quote: Techiman is also a commercial hub in Ghana, as it is the cross point of many different trunk roads from cities such as Sunyani, Kumasi, Wa, and Tamale.

clues.text: Rain here does not come just once a year. This land has a tropical savanna climate, with two wet seasons and then a dry season.
clues.narrowing: rules out places with only one wet season a year and no long dry season

source.quote: It has a tropical savanna climate, experiencing two wet seasons and a dry season.

clues.text: This city was founded in 1740. That year marks the start of its story as a town of the Bono state.
clues.narrowing: rules out towns founded in other years or outside the old Bono lands

source.quote: The city was founded in 1740, and was established as the Bono-Tekyiman state in the 1940s, after the Bono state's capital Bono Manso was taken over in 1723 by the Asante Empire.

clues.text: Farmers bring their crops to a huge open-air market here. It is one of the largest markets in all of West Africa.
clues.narrowing: rules out all but the West African city with one of the largest outdoor farm markets

source.quote: Techiman is the site of an outdoor agricultural market, one of the largest markets in West Africa.

clues.text: A vote in 2018 made new regions in Ghana. This city was picked as the capital of the Bono East Region.
clues.narrowing: confirms the capital city of Ghana's Bono East Region

source.quote: After a referendum in 2018 was passed with the focus of creating new regions in Ghana, Techiman was selected to be the capital of the newly-created region of the Bono East Region.
